name: labs/python-microscope__microscope
title: Cobolt laser (microscope.lights.cobolt:CoboltLaser)
intro: Cobolt laser (microscope.lights.cobolt:CoboltLaser), adapted from python-microscope/microscope. It reads `is_on`, `enabled`, `measured_power` and `status`; sets `power`; runs `enable_emission` and `disable_emission`. `enable_emission`: switch the laser emission on (the native enable). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
